name: NTE Host-Engine IPC Protocol Specification
description: Standardized binary framing, JSON envelope, ring-buffer data plane, sequence generation scopes, QPC clock domain, and command idempotency specification between .NET Native Host and Python Intelligence Engine.

versionPolicy.rule: During V2 strangler migration, exact protocolVersion '1.0.0' equality is enforced across Host and Engine.

sequenceScope.description: Host and Engine independently track monotonically increasing sequence counters per connection generation. When a new sessionNonce is negotiated in HELLO/HELLO_ACK, sequence counters for that connection generation reset. Messages bearing stale sessionNonce or sequences <= high-water mark within that generation are rejected with ERR_STALE_SESSION or ERR_STALE_SEQUENCE.

clockDomain.description: Both Host and Engine share the single hardware Windows QueryPerformanceCounter (QPC) clock domain normalized to nanoseconds (time.perf_counter_ns() in Python; Stopwatch.GetTimestamp() * 1_000_000_000 / Stopwatch.Frequency in .NET).
clockDomain.expiryEvaluation: Expiry is strictly evaluated by the receiver upon message receipt: if receiverNowNs >= expiresAtNs, the command is expired.

rules: If incoming command matches an active or completed (sessionId, commandId) with identical payload, return cached COMMAND_RESULT without re-execution.
If incoming command matches (sessionId, commandId) with differing action or parameters, reject fail-closed with ERR_COMMAND_ID_REUSE_MISMATCH.
If receiverNowNs >= expiresAtNs upon evaluation, reject with status EXPIRED.

controlPlane.framing: 4-byte little-endian uint32 payload length prefix followed by UTF-8 encoded JSON payload uniformly across all binary transports (Windows Named Pipe and stdio fallback)

dataPlane.fixedGeometrySource: slotCount, slotSizeBytes and mapTotalSizeBytes are pure functions of protocolVersion == '1.0.0'. Both peers derive them from the constants below; there is no accept/reject geometry handshake and no acceptedSlot* fields exist in protocol 1.0.0.
dataPlane.handshakeGeometryDeclaration: HELLO carries frameBufferName and frameBufferSize only. The Engine validates HELLO.frameBufferSize == mapTotalSizeBytes (33177856); a mismatch fails closed with ERR_RING_GEOMETRY_MISMATCH (PROTOCOL, isFatal true).
dataPlane.capacityInvariant: width <= maxWidth and height <= maxHeight and stride * height <= slotPayloadCapacityBytes. Frames exceeding capacity are rejected with ERR_FRAME_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED.

zeroCopy.clarificationNote: Physical virtual address mapping is zero-copy between processes; GPU-to-CPU texture readback involves D3D11 staging copy.

frameMetadataContract.rule: Each checked field must be present in the FRAME_READY payload and must exactly equal the FrameHeaderV1 value read from ring slot bufferIndex. No coercion and no tolerance.
frameMetadataContract.fieldNamingRule: Payload field names are identical to FrameHeaderV1 field names; the corner checksum is cornerChecksum in both places. The bare name 'checksum' is not part of protocol 1.0.0.
frameMetadataContract.pixelFormatType: integer enum identical to FrameHeaderV1.pixelFormat (int32); 1 == BGRA8. The string "BGRA8" is not a valid wire value.

fieldTypes.sessionId: string (non-empty; no UUID format is enforced by the v1 validator)
